[EN] Thulsa has an argon in there known as the Cardinal of Undeath.

I believe this "cardinal" is none other than Krivalga, one of Thulsa's most powerful necromancers. He's been strangely absent from battle.

Find him and kill him.
[ES] Thulsa tiene un argon ahí dentro conocido como el Cardinal of Undeath.

Creo que este "cardenal" no es otro que Krivalga, uno de los nigromantes más poderosos de Thulsa. Ha estado extrañamente ausente de la batalla.

Encuéntralo y mátalo.

[EN] So the Cardinal was Krivalga? Excellent. Krivalga was the closest thing Thulsa had to a high priest.

Nicely done, .
[ES] ¿Así que el Cardenal era Krivalga? Excelente. Krivalga era lo más cercano que Thulsa tenía a un sumo sacerdote.

Bien hecho, .
